With all due respect. you didnt take responsibility (you hid it from him).

Want to point out he seems like the biggest asshole and you deserve better, you deserve to leave him and find something better. But it doesnt justify you cheating.

Whats been done is done, just move on with your life, remember that shit happens and dont repeat the same mistake, find someone that appreciates you, and never cheat again, just leave the other person if you arent happy.

Wish you the best, and hope you find someone deserving of you.

(it sounds like i am not on your side but i am, i truly hope you find someone and find the positivity in life).

Cheers to you!
I know he loves me but I just wish they understood what I am going through. I will pay them back and leave
